API_BASE_URL.description: API gateway base URL for this stage, shared by all backend services; reference data is <base>/reference-data-service/.

USE_STUB_AUTH.description: Send the DEV stub bearer token instead of real authentication.

USE_FAKE_SIGN_IN.description: Use the Stage-1 fake sign-in instead of Entra (local stacks only; ADR 0019).

MSAL_CLIENT_ID.description: Entra External ID public-client app registration ID for this stage (not a secret).

MSAL_AUTHORITY_URL.description: Entra External ID (CIAM) authority URL for this stage's tenant.

MSAL_REDIRECT_URI.description: msauth:// redirect for the browser fallback; must match this app's package and signing key.

MSAL_API_SCOPE.description: Entra API scope requested at sign-in and for API access tokens, e.g. api://<app-id>/access_as_user.
